description: This file defines a test case for verifying the autoload behavior of a custom device backend in PyTorch. It includes a test class with a single test method that checks environment variables related to the autoloading process.

classes.name: TestDeviceBackendAutoload
classes.description: A test case class that verifies autoload functionality for a custom device backend in PyTorch.

methods.name: test_autoload(self)
methods.description: Checks the environment variables 'TORCH_DEVICE_BACKEND_AUTOLOAD' and 'IS_CUSTOM_DEVICE_BACKEND_IMPORTED' to ensure they are set correctly during autoload.
